externalReply.text: Selma, Noor will provide the signed residency letter and category table by 14:30 UTC today. The letter will state: Bracken’s service data remain in the EU in accordance with its regional annex, as described in the attached processing matrix. The attachment will expressly show the global identity directory, US telemetry, US trial support attachment and external PDF Preview cache, so your panel can see the limits. Application content is in Frankfurt and Dublin. The team is correcting the earlier questionnaire and cannot support the Friday zero-downtime promise.

The working interpretation is that service data in that sentence means the application content identified by the annex’s examples, rather than every operational category. The signed matrix’s merged annotation and your broader understanding remain disputed. Legal’s initial interpretation note is due tomorrow at 08:30; it may change that reading. The letter will therefore describe today’s facts and will not say that every category or historic access has stayed in the EU. Noor will update the wording if Legal later requires it.

No renewal or release is required. Noor will coordinate your authorized export and connector disablement, report control and export status by 14:30 and meet at 15:30. No production migration, deletion or subscription change is authorized. The EUR 12,000 labor approval and conditional October extension are available on their stated terms. Supported migration needs a passing rehearsal and your informed consent; its earliest forecast is September 23 and does not regionalize global identity.
